title_en: Provisions on the Real-name System for Personal Deposit Accounts

articles.content_en: Article 1: These Provisions are formulated for the purpose of ensuring the authenticity of personal deposit accounts and protecting the lawful rights and interests of depositors.

Article 2: Financial institutions within the territory of the People's Republic of China and individuals who open personal deposit accounts with financial institutions shall comply with these Provisions.
Article 3: For the purposes of these Provisions, "financial institutions" refers to institutions established and operating personal deposit business within the territory according to law.

Article 4: For the purposes of these Provisions, "personal deposit accounts" refers to Renminbi and foreign currency deposit accounts opened by individuals with financial institutions, including demand deposit accounts, time deposit accounts, demand/time optional deposit accounts, notice deposit accounts, and other forms of personal deposit accounts.

Article 6: When an individual opens a personal deposit account with a financial institution, he/she shall present his/her own identification document and use the real name.
Where an agent opens a personal deposit account with a financial institution on behalf of another person, the agent shall present the identification documents of both the principal and the agent.

Article 7: Where an individual opens a personal deposit account with a financial institution, the financial institution shall require him/her to present his/her own identification document, verify it, and record the name and number on the identification document. Where an agent opens a personal deposit account with a financial institution on behalf of another person, the financial institution shall require him/her to present the identification documents of both the principal and the agent, verify them, and record the names and numbers on the identification documents of both the principal and the agent.
If the individual fails to present his/her own identification document or fails to use the name on his/her own identification document, the financial institution shall not open a personal deposit account for him/her.

Article 8: Financial institutions and their staff members shall bear the responsibility of keeping confidential the information on personal deposit accounts.
A financial institution shall not provide any information on personal deposit accounts to any entity or individual, and shall have the right to refuse any request by any entity or individual to inquire into, freeze, or deduct the funds of an individual deposited with the financial institution; except as otherwise provided by law.

Article 9: Where a financial institution violates the provisions of Article 7 of these Provisions, the People's Bank of China shall give it a warning, and may impose a fine of not less than 1,000 yuan but not more than 5,000 yuan; if the circumstances are serious, it may also be ordered to suspend business for rectification, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be given disciplinary sanctions according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 10: For personal deposit accounts already opened with financial institutions before the coming into force of these Provisions, the relevant state provisions in force before the coming into force of these Provisions shall apply; after the coming into force of these Provisions, when handling the first personal deposit in the original account, if the original account has not used a real name, the real name shall be used in accordance with these Provisions.
Article 11: These Provisions shall be organized and implemented by the People's Bank of China.
Article 12: These Provisions shall come into force as of April 1, 2000.
